A paperclip-style button that opens the file picker and emits the chosen files as FileUIParts (data-URL encoded).

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/data/chat/Attachment.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { AttachmentButton } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/chat";
```
